text:
elaine: Pushed a small PR to modernize the Hello quickstart and onboarding flow. Main points: update to SDK8 async snippets, unify env var names (RW_API_KEY), remove legacy .rw_token example, fix Docker command, and run linkcheck. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/839
rob: Thanks — can you call out specific snippet diffs so reviewers know what to focus on?
elaine: Sure: (1) python sync -> async usage, (2) node sample -> top-level await + module note, (3) curl header canonicalization to `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`, (4) replace sed with cross-platform python one-liner.
omar: Linkcheck flagged a redirect from /integrations/kms to /security/kms on the onboarding page.
docs-ci: Linkcheck failed for PR 839: broken link at onboarding.md line 42 -> status 301.
kevin: Theres also a snippet portability problem: the README uses `sed -i` which breaks on macOS. Recommend a python one-liner or a short Node replace snippet.
elaine: Replaced sed with `python3 -c "import sys,os; s=open('config.tpl').read().replace('PLACEHOLDER', os.environ.get('RW_API_KEY','')) ; open('config','w').write(s)"` and added a note that python3 is required for that step. Pushed commit.
rob: In the JS example you switched to top-level await but didn't mention package.json "type":"module"; either note that or show an async IIFE for CommonJS.
omar: Added an alternative async IIFE example in the snippet.
docs-ci: snippet-tests passed except for docker port mismatch in container instructions.
elaine: Fixed Dockerfile EXPOSE/CMD to 8080 to match the sample app, and added a one-paragraph FAQ for common auth errors (missing header vs invalid token).
kevin: Quick devex LGTM. Can we add a one-line pointer to the KMS rotation guide for enterprise users who need HSM or automated rotation?
elaine: Added KMS link and a single-sentence note about rotating keys without downtime if you use env-var reloaders (systemd/supervisord). Merging after site build.
docs-ci: Site build succeeded, PR 839 merged to main and deployed to staging.
elaine: Verified staging and updated a tiny wording nit. Thanks everyone :tada:
